title: Eating Sounds
description: Replaces the default eating noise with distinct sounds for different foods
body:
# 🍎 Eating Sounds

**Eating Sounds** is a small, client-side mod that replaces the default eating sound with distinct sound sets for different foods.

Apples, berries, bread, carrots, cooked meat, raw meat, soups, fish, kelp, melon, cookies, chorus fruit, potatoes, beetroot, and more each get their own eating sound style. The result is still lightweight and vanilla-friendly, but food feels more varied and satisfying.

This mod is client-side only. You can use it on servers without requiring the server or other players to install it.

### ✨ Features

* **Custom Audio Variety:** Adds 45 new eating sound files.
* **Food Categorization:** Covers 15 food sound groups.
* **Pure Client Implementation:** Works client-side only.
